Violations carry civil penalties starting at $525 and possible refunds. New Yorkers can file complaints through a new online city portal.

title: Actor Imran Khan among several detained in Mumbai for supporting CJP protest

While the decision could affect his availability for upcoming international fixtures, the Al-Nassr forward has continued scoring, reaching 980 career goals. Ronaldo reportedly hopes to achieve the 1,000-goal milestone in a Portugal shirt, making the suspension particularly significant.

However, he failed to deliver on that commitment.

title: 'I think it should be taken out': Rahane joins calls to abolish Impact Player rule
description: Ajinkya Rahane has raised significant concerns regarding the Impact Player rule in the Indian Premier League. He argues that this rule stifles the development of all-rounders in Indian cricket, restricting their vital opportunities on the field. Although some teams have exploited this rule for higher scores, it diminishes the role of bowlers and all-rounders.

title: Michael Bloomberg’s $1bn gift made Johns Hopkins medical school tuition-free
description: In a groundbreaking move, Johns Hopkins University revealed a $1 billion contribution from Bloomberg Philanthropies to significantly improve financial assistance for graduate students. This generous funding extends free tuition to medical students from households earning under $300,000, while those from families with incomes up to $175,000 can access support for both tuition and living expenses.

title: Jeff Bezos invests $100 million to turn vacant land into parks in eight US cities
description: Jeff Bezos is allocating $100 million to convert neglected urban land into parks in eight American cities. The funding aims to revitalize vacant lots and industrial sites while enhancing community access to nature. Specific projects include restoring public spaces in Cleveland, creating parks in Indianapolis, and improving green areas in Salt Lake City. Cities such as Los Angeles and Little Rock will benefit from new recreational and gathering spaces.

title: Couple with legs chained found dead in Tapi river, Dhule police suspect suicide
description: Shyam Patil and his wife Sapna were discovered dead in the Tapi river in Dhule. Their bodies were chained together, indicating a possible suicide after their last phone call. Local residents reported seeing a motorcycle parked near the river before the discovery. Shyam had contacted his brother-in-law shortly before their presumed drowning, stating that everything was over.

title: Teacher denied gratuity for working past 60; court orders payment with 6% interest
description: A woman joined an educational institution in Faizabad as an assistant teacher on August 16, 1992. She continued working there until March 31, 2019, when she retired. However, the institution declined to pay her gratuity, arguing that the prescribed retirement age was 60 and she had remained in service until she was 62.
